name: @la/server
description: The composition root (ADR §2). The ONLY package permitted to depend on @la/lang-* packages (ADR §2.4 rule a): composeApp — pure DI, no container — with the literal-import registry, the contractVersion equality assert, the manifest parse, deriveCapabilities, and asset existence + spine-schema boot validation. Also (issue #10) the fixture-mode HTTP surface: the SSE endpoint streaming fixture tutor-message tokens[] with the hosting ADR's anti-buffering headers, and the shared learning-event route. The real hot-path turn loop that replaces the fixture token source is owned by #9.
